params.body:
Two things on the timeline charts (Patterns, Insights, Buffer).

- The tooltip opened to the right of the pointer, so on a chart at the right of a row the newest day's numbers fell off the screen. Within 240px of the right edge it now opens to the left.
- The Patterns chart counted each pattern on the day of its last signal: every pattern touched today piled onto today (875 on 2 October, of which 16 were new). It now counts by `createdAt` from pipeline PR alongside, labelled "New patterns per day", and falls back to the old date until that is deployed.
- The chart label is sentence case instead of spaced capitals.

Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling, e2e pass.
params.title: Timelines: tooltip on screen, new patterns per day
